cases.name: Stacy Elizabeth Witkowski
cases.about: She was a DOT inspector for the State of Wisconsin. She loved animals and especially her horses. She had 10 horses. She was excited about being a grandmother.
cases.narrative:
He brutally beat her in June of 2012. She had seven major brain surgeries and struggled with strokes, seizures and infections for the next four years. She lived her remaining days in a nursing home, struggling to move and communicate, before succumbing to her injuries.

She died of aspiration and the paramedic named Josh who now works in Rochester who transferred her worked with an ME and he insisted her COD be listed as homicide.

District Atty Angie Berenak.

cases.name: Beth Marie Parker
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Beth worked several years at Main Street Café in Bloomer where she fostered a love for baking. She also loved the outdoors and enjoyed hunting, fishing, camping & gardening. She had an amazing love for animals, forming bonds with many pets throughout the years."
